milestones.title: Output Data Access (MVP)
milestones.objective: Users can retrieve, filter, and explore the three core SPI output datasets with version support.

features.title: GitHub download engine
features.description: Internal function to fetch CSV from raw GitHub URLs, with error handling, version (branch) support, default = master

features.title: spi_get() for big three
features.description: Retrieve SPI_data.csv, SPI_index.csv, or aggregates as data.table; type argument selects which

features.title: Filtering in spi_get()
features.description: country, year, pillar, dimension arguments to subset before returning

features.title: spi_versions()
features.description: Query GitHub API for available branches, return as character vector

features.title: Package infrastructure
features.description: DESCRIPTION, roxygen2, testthat setup, namespace, LICENSE; R CMD check passes clean

features.title: Tests for Milestone 1
features.description: testthat coverage for spi_get(), filtering logic, error conditions, version handling

milestones.title: Inventory & Raw Data
milestones.objective: Users can interactively browse all available data (raw and output) and retrieve any raw data file.

features.title: GitHub tree crawler
features.description: Internal function using GitHub API to list directory contents recursively; cached with configurable refresh

features.title: Inventory cache system
features.description: Store crawled file tree locally in tools::R_user_dir(), with spi_update_inventory() to refresh

features.title: spi_inventory() interactive mode
features.description: Menu-driven: choose raw vs output, pillar (1-5) or misc/metadata, dimension, see files; works in interactive sessions

features.title: spi_inventory() programmatic mode
features.description: Non-interactive: return data.table of all files filtered by pillar, dimension, category; for scripts

features.title: spi_get_raw()
features.description: Retrieve any raw data CSV/Excel file by path or inventory selection; version support; uses readxl for .xlsx files

features.title: Tests for Milestone 2
features.description: Inventory display, cache refresh, raw data retrieval, edge cases

milestones.title: Documentation & Release
milestones.objective: Package is polished, documented, and ready for users.

features.title: README with examples
features.description: Setup, quick start, usage for each function

features.title: Vignette: SPI data workflows
features.description: End-to-end examples: get data, filter, analyze, visualize
